title: Fix the GoalSetupScreen "provably-dead — delete" verdict in docs/planning/on-device-preflight-cheatsheet.md before anyone acts on it

evidence.quote: Delete the whole file lib/features/scheduler/presentation/screens/goal_setup_screen.dart (both GoalSetupForm and GoalSetupScreen are dead)... Do NOT spend on-device test effort mounting GoalSetupScreen/GoalSetupForm: there is no in-app path to it.
**Status:** Scoped, product decisions made (2026-06-14). Phase 1 in progress.
**Date:** 2026-06-18 · **Status:** Planning — implementation-ready; Wave 1 builds on proven harness...

why: track_detail_screen.dart (a churn-hotspot file) wires `_openGoalEdit`, called from an onTap at line 692, which pushes `GoalSetupScreen` via `Navigator.push(MaterialPageRoute(...))` at line 788 — this is the live "Edit Goal" flow, reachable and reachable-only via Navigator (never @RoutePage-routed, which is exactly why the cheatsheet's router/`.gr.dart` grep missed it). A later doc in the same repo, e2e-test-suite-plan.md (2026-06-18), independently and correctly classifies GoalSetupScreen as reachable ("Navigator push only"), directly contradicting this cheatsheet's "provably-dead" verdict. The cheatsheet is explicitly framed as an action list ("pre-flight cheat-sheet") with an unambiguous, confident delete instruction; anyone or any agent treating it as current guidance today would delete a live, user-reachable screen — a real functional regression (the Edit-Goal button on Track Detail would 404/crash).
recommendation: Strike or correct the GoalSetupScreen entry (cross-reference e2e-test-suite-plan.md's classification) and add a one-line banner to the top of the cheatsheet stating its verdicts are a snapshot as of the 2026-05-31 commit and must be re-grepped before acting, since — as this very file shows — the underlying code moves.
acceptance_criteria: The GoalSetupScreen section no longer recommends deletion, or is removed/marked resolved-incorrect.
A dated "snapshot, re-verify before acting" disclaimer is added near the top of the file.
Spot check: `grep -rn 'GoalSetupScreen(' learning_tracker/lib` continues to show the track_detail_screen.dart call site as the acceptance check that the doc no longer disagrees with.

corrections: docs/planning/e2e-test-suite-plan.md 'Non-routed screens' row is at line 18, not 15 as cited; quote text itself is verbatim-correct and easily located.

mergedFrom: Update stale status/title headers in living docs/planning/ files whose own body or code shows the work is already done
